post.body:
Interest rates have always played a pivotal role in shaping the real estate market, and 2024 is proving to be no exception. As these rates fluctuate, they directly influence how many homes are bought and sold, as well as what buyers can afford. Let’s take a closer look at how rising interest rates are affecting the Northern Colorado real estate market, with a focus on Fort Collins, Loveland, and the surrounding areas.

How Interest Rates Are Impacting Sales:

One of the standout trends from August 2024 is the clear link between rising interest rates and the decline in home sales volume. A closer look at the data from Fort Collins, Loveland, and Greeley shows that as interest rates climb, both new listings and sales volume tend to drop. Higher rates are putting the squeeze on buyers' budgets, leading many to either pause their home search or put off buying altogether.

  • Single-Family Home Sales: Both Fort Collins and Loveland experienced a drop in single-family home sales, with Fort Collins seeing a 19.11% decline and Loveland dropping by 26.1% compared to last year.
  • Attached Dwelling Sales: Fort Collins bucked the trend with a 25% increase in attached dwelling sales, while Loveland saw a 22.7% decrease.

Price Trends and Affordability:

Despite fewer sales, prices are still climbing for single-family homes in both cities. In Fort Collins, the average sales price rose by 9.3%, pushing it above $700,000, while Loveland saw an 8.3% increase in average prices. This upward trend is largely due to limited inventory—fewer homes on the market means that those available are still in demand, even as buyers face higher borrowing costs.

On the flip side, attached dwellings in both Fort Collins and Loveland saw a dip in prices. The average price for attached homes in Fort Collins fell by 9.4%, while Loveland experienced a 10.8% decrease. This suggests that as interest rates rise, buyers are becoming more price-conscious, especially in the attached home market, where affordability may be a bigger factor.

What’s Next for Interest Rates?

With interest rates constantly in flux, it’s difficult to predict the exact path of the market for the remainder of the year. What’s clear is that Northern Colorado’s real estate market remains competitive, even in the face of higher borrowing costs. Whether you’re a buyer or a seller, interest rates will continue to play a significant role in shaping your decisions.

As we move through the rest of 2024, keeping an eye on interest rate trends is more important than ever. Even a small change in rates can significantly impact how much you’ll pay for a home or how quickly you’ll be able to sell. If you’re thinking about buying or selling, staying informed is key, and partnering with an experienced real estate agent will ensure you have the guidance you need to navigate these shifting conditions.
